title: Materials Data Vocabulary (NIST Materials Resource Registry, RDA IMRR WG)
notes: Not a GitHub artifact: the pin is the NIST Public Data Repository distribution of the DOI-versioned publication doi:10.18434/T4/1435037, the only authoritative machine-readable copy. Immutability is equivalent to a release asset: the filename is revision-dated, NIST publishes a sidecar checksum that matches this sha256, and the prior revision (20171102) was superseded by adding a new dated file. Pure SKOS, 993 concepts, self-contained, no OWL constructs, so ontologyIri is the skos:ConceptScheme subject. This is the RDA International Materials Resource Registries WG vocabulary (Data Science Journal doi:10.5334/dsj-2021-018). Public domain as a work of NIST employees, attribution requested. Reasoning is skipped: the file declares no OWL constructs, and a reasoned run yields an empty graph.
